notes.title: The Little Nightmares 3 demo has already convinced me that co-op is the way forward for the series
notes.notes: My experience with the Little Nightmares series has never been solo. Although both the first and second games only support one player, while I've made my way through the hopeless settings of both, I've always been watched. My sister sat screaming in fear over my shoulder while I navigated the first one, and my housemates in university happily attempted to instruct me through the second. I was fully ready for Little Nightmares 3 to be the first I actually played on my own, until the demo released and I realised it had co-op—foiled again... Read more.

notes.title: Little Nightmares 3 has a pint-sized bad dream demo out now, ahead of its arrival next month
notes.notes:
Supermassive Games have put out a demo for Little Nightmares 3, so you can give the spooky co-op puzzler a whirl before it arrives in October. "Step into the Necropolis", the studio say. Go on then, that sounds like it has zero potential to end badly.

As our Nic conveyed earlier this year, Little Nightmares 3's coming out October 10th. That date was unaffected by Supermassive laying off up to 36 people and delaying interstellar horror Directive 8020 in July.

Read more

notes.title: You can now explore a bitesize chunk of the Necropolis thanks to the Little Nightmares 3 demo
notes.notes: Little Nightmares 3 has released a short demo ahead of its launch on October 10, which will be the first hands-on look we've got at the new setting: The Nowhere. More specifically, the demo whisks you straight to the main city of the game, the Necropolis, a desolated location lost to time and sat in the middle of a desert... Read more.

notes.title: Little Nightmares III - Extended Stories
notes.notes: [h3][b]Little Nightmares[/b] continues to expand beyond video games. Several other projects have been announced during [b]Little Nightmares Showcase[/b] on [i]June 24[/i], spanning a variety of media such as [b]comic books[/b], [b]podcasts[/b] and [b]more[/b]. [/h3][p][/p][h2][b]The Sounds of Nightmares[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]The [b]Sounds of Nightmares[/b], the [b]podcast series[/b] that has surpassed [i]2 million listens[/i], will receive a second season which is currently being written.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="yzX5UrnKGj4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Little Nightmares: Descent to Nowhere[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Little Nightmares: Descent to Nowhere[/b], the [b]comic book series[/b] published by [i]Titan Comics[/i] will be releasing the first issue in [b]October 2025[/b]. The comic follows two parallel stories. [b]Hush[/b], a timid mute girl wakes up in a jail cell. Desperate to escape, she befriends another prisoner, [b]Mono[/b], who understands this world far better than her, they will have to find a way out of a very dark Dungeon. [/h3][p][/p][h3]Elsewhere, [b]Myra[/b] is a detective exhausted by life who meets someone who reignites her will to make a difference. They resume investigating unresolved cases of children vanishing year after year without a trace.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="FK30jqgA_oM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]The comic book series will be published in English and will be available for pre-purchase starting in [i]July[/i] at your local comic bookstore and worldwide on [b][url="https://titan-comics.com/"]Titan’s website[/url].[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Little Nightmares: The Lonely Ones[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Little Nightmares: The Lonely Ones[/b], the [b]young adult horror novel[/b] written by [i]E.C. Myers[/i] and published by [i]Scholastic[/i] will be out in [b]September 2025[/b]. [/h3][h3]It follows [b]Ruse[/b], a young child, who awakens in an unfamiliar, shaking room with two other kids she doesn't know—a small girl with a frayed rope dangling from her neck and a starved-looking boy wearing a tattered mask over his mouth and nose. She is in a nightmarish carnival and knows one thing: it's not safe, and she needs to flee. [/h3][h3]Will she be able to make it out? Will her companions of misfortune reveal themselves to be friends or enemies? [/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]As a final surprise, [b]a teaser for a stop motion project[/b] developed in collaboration with the [i]studio Taller del Chucho[/i] has been shown with more information to be unveiled later.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="Y4CM3i39Z08;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Little ones, pre-order Little Nightmares III now![/b][/h2][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392860/Little_Nightmares_III/"]Little Nightmares III on Steam[/url][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Until Dawn devs Supermassive lay off "up to 36" workers, delay interstellar horror Directive 8020
notes.notes:
Supermassive Games, best known for developing the likes of Until Dawn and The Dark Pictures Anthology, have announced they've begun the consultation process for a round of redundancies that'll affect "up to 36" staff. As part of this, sci-fi horror game Directive 8020 has had its release delayed to early next year.

Meanwhile, Supermassive have confirmed that the development of puzzler Little Nightmares 3 hasn't been affected by these job cuts, with that game still being on track to come out October 10th.

Read more

notes.title: I played some Little Nightmares 3, and it's the best horror about being lost and tiny in an unfathomable hellscape since Little Nightmares 2
notes.notes: I liked the first two Little Nightmares games, and while I've only played an hour of it, I'll probably like Little Nightmares 3 too. It's functionally the same. These games are cinematic platformers mixing the solemnity of Inside and Limbo with a surreal, almost Burton-esque take on horror. They're not mechanically innovative at all; the strength of the series lies in its atmosphere and spectacle, and based on what I've played of Little Nightmares 3, that's not about to change... Read more.

notes.title: Little Nightmares available today on mobile, on iOS, and Android 📱
notes.notes:
[h1]The charming horror adventure tale Little Nightmares is now available on mobile, for players to enjoy everywhere![/h1]

[h3]In [b]Little Nightmares[/b], you will have to help Six escape The Maw – a vast, mysterious vessel inhabited by corrupted souls who don’t approve of wayward children. As you progress through your journey, untangle each room's tricky puzzles, hide in the shadows of the monsters' lairs and use your imagination to stay out of harm's way!

[b]Bandai Namco Europe[/b] has worked with [b]Playdigious[/b], a developer known for its mobile adaptations of successful games from console and PC, to bring the atmospheric puzzle platformer to iOS and Android. 

This port is tailored for mobile devices to offer the most comfortable and immersive experience for mobile players.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=gUEILRgdx_A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The game has been carefully adapted for mobile with a revamped interface, Game Center achievements, mobile cloud save and 3 Control modes.

Discover the different ways you'll be able to explore the Maw on mobile, on iOS and Android phones.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=C97nkoqdHb8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][list]
[*] [b]Controller Mode[/b] offers users the possibility of playing with MFi controllers (controllers made for Apple devices) while two new Control modes let you to play with the touchscreen.
[*] [b]Standard Mode[/b] lets you play with the various controls appearing on the screen...
[*]...while [b]Immersive Mode[/b] offers greater immersion in the game's atmosphere. 
[/list]
[/h3]

[h1]Special Mobile Launch Giveaway[/h1]

[h3]In celebration of the release, [b]we’re giving away 30 copies of the mobile version[/b] – 15 for iOS and 15 for Android – to 30 lucky children who register for the contest here on our site.

[url=https://bnent.eu/LN1_MobileGiveaway][b]Join in by December 19, 2023[/b][/url] for your chance to win a copy for yourself or download the game on the app store of your choice on December 12, 2023![/h3]

notes.notes:
[h1]The Sounds of Nightmares, the eerie psychological thriller podcast, has been listened more than a million times![/h1]

[h3]In The Sounds of Nightmares, follow the story of Noone, a timid young girl, committed to The Counties Psychiatric Institute due to her ever-worsening nightmare disorder. She is placed under the care of The Counsellor who has dedicated his life to helping kids overcome their ailments. As their sessions unfold, The Counsellor's past and Noone's nightmares are destined to collide.

Along with the different episodes, listeners will get deeper into Noone’s head and her nightmares and be immersed in the various places she visits when she sleeps. They will feel in the same position than Otto questioning the reality of this dreamlike world as they go deeper and deeper to understand what is going on.[/h3]

[h2]The six episodes are available on all major streaming platforms,[b] in English / French / German / Italian / Spanish[/b]. If you haven't listened yet, [url=https://245360.qrfy.com/p/RAnK---xKf]experience the podcast for yourself ↓[/url][/h2]
